summaryZh: Mesarwi Lab 研究低氧如何影响生理结果，涉及肺损伤、肥胖相关心血管代谢、肝细胞 HIF-1 及间歇性低氧中的限时进食。实验室明确采用体内研究方法。
researchQuestions: 不同低氧模型如何影响重要生理结局？
低氧条件下，肥胖如何影响心血管与代谢生理？
低氧条件下，肝细胞 HIF-1 如何影响葡萄糖和脂质代谢？

evidence.quote: The Mesarwi Lab at UC San Diego
Our laboratory uses in vivo approaches to understand ​how different models of hypoxia influence important physiological outcomes.

The impact of lung tissue hypoxia in acute lung injury in COVID-19 How obesity impacts cardiovascular and metabolic physiology in hypoxia How hepatocyte hypoxia inducible factor-1 (HIF-1) impacts glucose and lipid metabolism in hypoxia The impact of time restricted feeding on dysglycemia in intermittent hypoxia
